source_text:
陈老师，您好。上次电话后我们又核了一遍六月工作坊的人数和空间，我想先把现在能确认的部分发给您，免得两边分别在排。报名表里有二十四个人，其中四个人说可能晚到，但我们没有答应为迟到者单独重讲。我们希望使用二楼东侧教室，日期是6月18日，时间14:00到17:00，上午布置不在这次申请里。如果那个教室不能借，我们也可以考虑一楼的小厅，不过需要先看照片才能判断投影位置，不能现在就确认小厅。设备方面，我们自带电脑和一只转接头，请场馆提供投影仪与二十六把椅子。茶水可以由大家自己带，不必请您安排。
费用现在有一个容易误会的地方：去年的报价不能直接沿用。我们的项目预算上限是1800元，这个数字包含场地和设备使用，但不是请您一定按这个价接；如果正常报价超过了，也请按实际情况告诉我，我们再回去调整内容。财务还在确认能否接受电子普通发票，周五之前不一定有答复。没确认前，烦请不要替我们开票，也不要先替我们垫付。
另外，报名页上写的“适合第一次尝试的人”是说内容门槛，不是保证每个人都能完成作品。授课老师希望保留这个区别。您若方便，能否在本周四17:00前告知教室是否可用、场地与设备的分项报价，以及是否需要另签安全告知书？如果您需要更长时间核实，先告诉我预计回复的日子也可以。收到这些信息后，我们才能发出最终场地确认。谢谢您前面帮忙看场地。

prompt: Rewrite this email to a university lab coordinator. Make the two requests easy to find and preserve the limits on what I can promise. Return the email body only.
source_text:
Dear Morgan,
I have been going back through the notes from our visit, and there are two things on which I still need your help before I can make a plan for the students. We are bringing twelve visiting students on 9 July, with arrival at 10:30 and departure at noon. They have all completed our own introductory safety session. I understand that this does not replace your laboratory induction. Could you tell me whether the local induction can take place within that visiting window, and whether there is anything the students need to read before they arrive? We can ask them to read material in advance, but I cannot certify that they have passed your induction.
The other issue is access. Two students have asked whether the route from the north entrance to the demonstration room involves stairs. They have not shared medical details with me, and I do not want to ask them for those in an email that goes to the whole group. If you have a description of that route, or a contact who can discuss access privately, please send it to me. Please do not copy the student group into that discussion at this stage.
We had hoped to see the imaging equipment while it was running. If that is not possible on the day, a demonstration with the equipment switched off would still be useful. There is no need to arrange a special live run just for us. I will collect questions from the students beforehand, although I cannot promise that every student will send one. If possible, please reply by 2 July so I can send a single practical note to the group. Thank you for helping us prepare.

昨天夜班我们做的是冷库温度记录的补录，不是温控设备维修。A区的纸质记录共有三十六张，已经录入三十四张；另外两张上的时间看不清，留在异常夹，没有按相邻记录推算。B区有一张记录写着“低于下限”，但没有温度数字，我们只录了原文，没有填入最低温度。录入表已放到共享盘，文件名是 coldroom-log-r3.csv，表里空值表示原纸缺少可辨认数字，并不表示零度。

还有一个交接细节：共享盘里上周的 r2 文件没有删除，是为了保留追溯；本轮工作也没有改变库内货物的放行状态。出货仍由当班负责人按原流程判断，录入人员无权凭这张补录表批准出货。我的建议是先把显示屏异常登记给设备组，由他们判断检查范围；这个建议还没有得到批准。

Unsuitable items must stay with the donor; we have not arranged a disposal service. There will be a short briefing beside the west gate before setup begins. Anyone who cannot lift boxes can help with sorting or the information table. Volunteers do not need to explain why they prefer those tasks. Please ask people to tell Nia by Thursday evening if they will be absent or arrive late, so she can adjust assignments. prompt: 这是虚构内部工具 Trail 的已批准操作笔记。改写成新同事能跟随的操作指南；保留技术行为，只组织和解释文字。命令、输出字面值与文件名不改，不补工具能力。只返回指南。
source_text:
Trail 用来把本地实验记录打包到暂存目录，不会上传到远端。第一次使用时，先向项目管理员确认自己拿到的是测试副本。原始记录放在 records/，工具只读取这个目录；暂存目录应为空，不能使用上一次打包留下的目录。我们在这份指南里统一用 stage-07/，但这只是示例名。若管理员还没有给你测试副本，就先停在这里，不要直接拿生产记录试。
先运行 `trail check --input records/`。这一步只检查格式，不创建包，也不修复记录。输出是 `READY` 才能继续；如果显示 `MISSING_DATE`，请把对应文件名交给记录负责人补日期，自己不要根据文件修改时间推测。检查报告会列出文件名，但不会判断实验内容是否正确。显示 `READY` 也不代表已经得到对外分享许可，这两个判断不归同一环节处理。
检查通过后，确认 stage-07/ 里没有文件，再运行 `trail pack --input records/ --out stage-07/`。打包成功会生成 bundle.zip 和 manifest.json。清单记录包内文件名和校验值，不包含访问口令。工具不会删除 records/ 中的原文件。暂存目录只用于本次交接，不要把另一批实验记录混进来；若发现来源混杂，也应先交管理员核对批次。如果命令报告输出目录非空，停下来请管理员确认；不要为了让命令通过而自行删除目录内容。
最后运行 `trail verify --manifest stage-07/manifest.json`。输出 `MATCH` 表示当前暂存包与清单一致，仍然不能证明实验结论成立。若输出 `DIFF`，先保留现场，交管理员核对，不要覆盖清单再验证一次。把 `MATCH` 和打包日期记录到交接单之后，交接给项目管理员，由管理员决定是否迁移到共享区。本人完成打包不等于拥有对外分享权。本文没有解包、上传或清理旧包的步骤，也不要求操作者做这些动作。

prompt: Rewrite the approved notes below as a beginner-facing how-to for the fictional LensDesk application. Preserve the operations and stop conditions; do not invent buttons. Return the guide only.
source_text:
This procedure is for comparing two saved image sets in LensDesk. It does not modify the original images. Before opening a comparison, make sure that the two sets have already been exported by the imaging team. The viewer cannot export images from a camera. The set labelled reference is the earlier observation, not a statement that it is the correct result. Both sets must belong to the same sample. If the sample labels disagree, stop and ask the imaging team to identify the files rather than editing the labels yourself.
In the viewer, choose Compare, then select the reference set in the left picker and the later set in the right picker. Select Load. A grey preview means that the viewer has not yet loaded the pixels; it does not show an empty image. Wait for the label Loaded under both pickers before making observations. If the viewer reports Set incomplete, close the comparison and ask the imaging team for a complete export. Repeatedly selecting Load does not recover missing files.
Use the linked zoom control to inspect the same region in both sets. This control changes the display only. It does not register the images or correct differences in camera position. If the edges do not line up, record that limitation with your observations. You may switch linked zoom off to inspect one image more closely, but return it to the linked state before recording a side-by-side observation.
To save a note, enter a description in Observation and select Save note. A saved note includes the two set identifiers and the text you entered. It does not include a screenshot. Copying the note to a report therefore does not give the report reader access to the image sets. Ask the imaging team separately if a report needs images. Do not describe a visible change as a measured change in size: this workflow supplies no scale calibration or measurement tool.

prompt: 将这份虚构队列服务 ParcelQ 的设计说明改成新加入后端团队的工程师能读懂的参考说明。允许重组，不能改合同、补算法或引入外部默认。代码和字段名原样保留。只返回说明。
source_text:
ParcelQ 的接收接口返回已接收，表示服务把任务记录到了持久存储中，不表示任务已经执行。调用方拿到 `receipt_id` 后，可以用它查询该次提交记录。任务真正执行成功时，状态才会变成 `done`。如果调用方在收到响应前断开连接，它可能不知道任务是否已经被接收，不能只凭连接中断判断服务端没有任务。
`dedupe_key` 的用途是把短时间内重复提交识别为同一项工作。对同一项目、同一键值，服务在首次接收后的十分钟内返回原提交的 `receipt_id`，不再创建第二个任务。这个窗口从首次接收计算，不随每次重复请求延长。超过十分钟再用同一键，可能创建新任务；文档没有保证必定创建，也没有提供永久去重。不同项目即使用了相同键值，也不适用这里的跨请求合并规则。
任务执行失败时，服务最多自动重试两次，也就是首次执行之外再尝试两次。失败记录并不会在开始重试时消失，因此查询时看到过一次失败，不代表任务最终必然失败。状态 `failed_final` 表示自动尝试已经结束，并非说明人工永远不能重新提交。人工重新提交仍要考虑上面那个十分钟窗口，否则可能拿回原提交记录，而不是产生新任务。
服务为每次执行保留开始时间和结束时间，但是没有承诺不同任务按提交顺序开始，也没有承诺按提交顺序结束。一个小任务晚提交、早结束，不足以说明队列丢失了之前的大任务。排查时应先查各自的 `receipt_id`。调用方也不应把任务结束时间与响应接收时间混用：前者是执行记录中的时间，后者是客户端观察到接口响应的时间。
示例返回为 `{"status":"accepted","receipt_id":"r-17"}`。它只展示接收响应的形状，不能据此推断查询接口的字段、任务优先级或者计费规则。本说明也不对调用方业务的幂等性作保证；十分钟内的任务合并与业务端的重复扣款防护不是同一份合同。

prompt: Edit this reference note for analysts who are comfortable with spreadsheets but new to the fictional metric Window Share. Explain the distinctions clearly using only the supplied definitions. Return the reference note, with no invented examples or formulas.
source_text:
Window Share describes the proportion of eligible observation windows that contain at least one recorded visit. A window is a complete thirty-minute interval during the study's scheduled observation hours. An interval is eligible only if its sensor was marked available for the whole interval. A visit recorded in a window that is not eligible does not enter either side of the ratio. The metric is therefore not the proportion of all visits that happened during scheduled hours.
Each eligible window contributes either zero or one to the numerator. Three visits in one eligible window still contribute one, not three. The denominator is the number of eligible windows, including eligible windows with no recorded visit. If there are no eligible windows, the report displays N/A. That value is not a zero share and must not be included as zero when calculating a summary across sites.
Consider the provided training record: Site North has ten eligible windows, and four of them contain visits. Site South has two eligible windows, both with visits. North's Window Share is 40%, and South's is 100%. Combining their eligible windows produces six visit-containing windows out of twelve eligible windows, or 50%. Taking the simple average of the two site percentages instead produces 70%; that answers a different question by giving each site the same weight. Neither should be labelled as the other.
Availability is recorded by the study team rather than inferred from whether visits occurred. A window with no visits is not automatically unavailable. A site with frequent sensor outages may have a high Window Share over its few eligible windows, so the report must show eligible-window counts beside the share. The metric by itself does not establish the number of people served, the length of their visits, or whether demand was satisfied. It is a descriptive measure of these recorded windows, not a causal estimate of the effect of changing opening hours.

prompt: 只重写第二段以减少术语感，第一段逐字不变。

本次为虚构服务纸匣的2.6版更新，功能名称为“批次标签”。它允许团队管理员为一次导入的文档添加同一标签，然后在文档列表中按该标签筛选。已经存在的文档可以由管理员手动补标签，但不会因为升级自动获得标签。普通成员能够按已有标签筛选，无权创建或批量改标签。一个批次当前最多关联三个标签，标签名字最多二十个字符；限制由产品合同确定，文案不可自行调整。
上线采用分批方式：6月3日起，先向参加试用并已确认的十二个团队开放。其余团队看到功能的日期还没有确定，不应写成全量上线，也不要暗示管理员能通过重新登录提前获得资格。试用团队无需迁移文档，原有检索和访问权限不变。给文档加标签不会让其他原本无权访问的人获得权限。管理员若希望试用，应联系现有客户支持入口登记，但登记并不保证本轮开通。
本次更新没有标签自动生成，没有按内容推荐标签，也不支持跨团队共用标签。用户问到这些能力时，说明当前范围即可，不能把内部讨论里的可能方向写成下个版本的承诺。使用标签筛选是整理文档的另一种方式，我们没有测过节省多少时间，也没有足够证据承诺会减少多少重复劳动。
试用期间价格沿用各团队现有合同，不能由这段记录推导出正式版免费。管理员可以在设置页的“批次标签”入口查看自己是否已开通；入口未出现时，先按未开通处理，无需重新导入文档。说明页地址为 https://docs.example.org/zhixiang/2.6/labels ，需要原样保留。

prompt: Write release copy for existing users from the approved fictional product notes. Keep it helpful and restrained; include limitations that affect using the feature. Return the copy only.
source_text:
Harbor Notes version 1.8 adds a reading queue for individual accounts. A user can add a note to the queue from its menu and remove it after reading. The queue is private to that account. It is not a shared team task list, and adding a note does not notify its author. Notes still follow their existing access rules; the queue does not keep access after the user loses permission to the original note.
The feature will appear for accounts on the Standard plan on 12 September. It is not included for Guest accounts. Enterprise availability has not been scheduled. The team has approved the Standard launch date, but has not approved any statement about future availability for other account types. Users do not need to reinstall the application. An open browser tab may need to be refreshed before the queue appears.
A queue holds up to forty notes. When it is full, the user must remove an item before adding another one. Removing a queue item does not delete the original note. There is no automatic archive of completed reading, and the product does not measure how long a user spends reading. We have no study showing that this feature improves learning or team productivity, so those should not appear as promises.
This release does not change the Standard plan price. That does not establish that future plans or features will have the same price. Existing keyboard shortcuts remain unchanged. The approved support address is help@harbor.example.org. The copy should direct users there if the feature is missing after they have refreshed a Standard-plan account on or after the launch date.

prompt: 把这份合成研究便笺改写为给社区管理组的分析短文。既要有可辨认的建议，也要让读者分清观察、可能解释与未知。不得补研究或引文。保留所给数字及其分母。只返回短文。
source_text:
我们在三个社区试行晚间开放阅览室，想知道延长开放能否让更多住户使用空间。记录只覆盖五月的四个周三，没有随机分配社区，也没有试行前同口径的到访数据。东桥的开放时间由18点延到20点，四晚共记到访八十人次；北湾没有改时间，四晚共四十八人次；石巷延到21点，四晚共一百零二人次。这些都是门口计数的人次，不是去重人数，有人一晚可能来回进出。
三个社区的阅览室大小不同，东桥和石巷试行期间还各办过一次亲子活动，北湾没有。我们不知道亲子活动占了多少到访，也没有逐小时记录，因此不能从总数算出延长的那两个或三个小时各带来多少人次。石巷到访最多，可以描述为这四个周三的观察结果，但不能据此直接判定21点是所有社区最合适的关门时间。
我们另收了二十七份自愿填写的反馈，其中十九份希望延长开放，五份认为现有时间够用，三份没有勾选这一题。不能把十九除以二十四得到的比例写成全体住户支持率，未填写反馈的人是否支持我们不知道。反馈表里提到的主要困难是下班后赶不到，另有两人提到回家路线照明不足。这是两份反馈里的担忧，不是我们已经查证的照明安全事故。
我的倾向是保留一个月试行，并补记每小时到访与活动安排，同时由管理组另行核对晚间值守成本。这个建议还未讨论通过，也不意味着要让志愿者无偿延长值班。若管理组不同意继续试行，现有材料仍可以作为设计下一次观察的起点。现在不宜发布“延长开放让使用率翻倍”的结论，因为我们连可比的试行前分母都没有。也不宜把资料不足理解成延长开放肯定无效；我们尚不能在这两种强结论之间作判断。

prompt: Rewrite this synthetic analysis for a manager deciding whether to expand a repair service. Keep the recommendation distinguishable from the evidence. Do not bring in external studies. Return the analysis only.
source_text:
The repair desk ran a six-week trial of appointment reminders. During the first three weeks, 60 appointments were booked and 18 were missed. During the next three weeks, when reminders were used, 80 appointments were booked and 16 were missed. The missed-appointment share was therefore 30% in the first period and 20% in the second. That is a difference of ten percentage points; it is not a fall of ten percent relative to the first rate.
This comparison is useful but incomplete. The trial did not assign appointments randomly to reminder and no-reminder groups. The second period also included two Saturday sessions, while the first had none. We do not know whether those sessions attracted people with different schedules, and the notes do not record how many people received or read a reminder. We can say that the second period had a lower recorded missed-appointment share. We cannot isolate the effect of the reminder from these records.
After the trial, staff invited feedback from everyone who attended during its final week. Twelve people responded, and nine said the reminder was useful. We do not have the number of people invited, so a response rate cannot be calculated. Nine out of twelve describes these respondents, not everyone who booked an appointment or everyone in the neighbourhood. No survey was sent to people who missed an appointment.
My recommendation is to continue reminders for another trial period while recording delivery status and keeping opening times comparable. This is a proposed next step, not an approved budget decision. The service manager would still need to consider staff time and messaging costs; neither has been measured here. If continuation is not possible, the current result should be described as a promising observation with unresolved alternatives, rather than a proven saving or evidence that reminders never help.

source_text: 这周六我第一次去社区修补角，带的是一把伞骨折了的旧伞。来之前我以为到了就有人替我修，实际是志愿者先把工具摆好，再让我自己拆开布边。我用小剪刀剪错了一根线，志愿者没笑，只把放螺丝的小盒子推近了一点，说先别急着缝回去。那把伞最后还没有修好，因为缺一枚合适的铆钉，我把零件装回纸袋，约好下周再来看看。下周有没有零件还不确定，对方没有保证。我在桌边待了一个半小时，旁边有人补书包，有人试着让台灯重新亮起来。我没问他们的名字，也不知道他们平时做什么。离开时我帮忙把桌面擦了，手指上还有一点黑色的油。我想分享的只是这次没有修完的小经历，不想把它写成一场改变生活的顿悟。也不用号召别人都去；我不知道修补角是否还能接待更多人。

prompt: Use this personal account to write three distinct candidate posts for a small, friends-only feed. Each should have a different angle and organisation, not just different adjectives. You may select details; do not invent a lesson, dialogue, or a completed success. Return the three numbered candidates only.
source_text:
I spent Sunday morning trying to make a paper map of the walks I actually take around my neighbourhood. I had an old street map and a red pencil. The first thing I noticed was how little of the printed map I used: the corner shop, the library, the station and one narrow path behind the playing field. I drew the path in the wrong place at first and rubbed it out. There is still a pink mark where it used to be.
I thought I would finish the map before lunch, but I stopped after about two hours because I could not remember where one side street came out. I have not gone back to check it yet. Nobody else has seen the map, and I am not planning to sell copies or start a mapping project. The thing I want to share is the oddly patchy drawing on my kitchen table. It made me notice a few gaps in my own knowledge of streets I often pass, but I do not want to claim that I discovered a new way of living or understood the whole neighbourhood.

prompt: 把这篇个人非虚构草稿整理得连贯一些，可调段落，保留叙述者的克制和记忆边界，不补对白或成长结论。只返回成稿。
source_text:
父亲搬出老房子那天，我负责把厨房抽屉清空。房子不是拆迁，也不是卖了，只是他觉得一个人住三楼，上下买菜有些费力，决定先搬到妹妹住的小区。至于以后还回不回来，我们那天没有讨论。我拿了三个纸箱，以为半小时就能装完，最后在厨房待到中午。
抽屉里有一把缺了半截塑料柄的削皮刀，两卷已经发黄的保鲜膜，还有一叠用皮筋捆住的煤气缴费单。最旧的一张日期看不清了，我没有拿放大镜细看。小时候家里是否就用过这把削皮刀，我也不能确定。我记得母亲会把苹果切成四块，却不记得她用的是什么刀。她去世已经七年，那天我没有和父亲提起苹果的事。
父亲在门口给纸箱写字，把“厨房”写在侧面，不写在箱顶，说这样叠起来也找得到。这句话我记得意思，原话大概不是现在写的这样。我问缴费单要不要留，他说先带着。我没有追问，也不认为这一句就能说明他舍不得整套房子。妹妹上午来了一趟，带走窗台上的两盆植物，之后去接孩子。她并没有参与我们中午对账单的整理。
吃午饭时，我们在折叠桌边分了一盒炒饭。冰箱还没有断电，里面只剩半瓶酱油和一袋冻得看不出内容的东西。我没有打开那袋东西，也不知道后来是谁处理的。饭后我把削皮刀放进最后一个箱子，没问它是否还能用。最后出门的是父亲，我在楼下等车，看不到他锁门的动作。
我后来有几次想把那天写成一次郑重告别，但这样写不符合我的记忆。我们一直在找胶带、算箱子的数量、确认钥匙放在哪儿。离开前没有人在门口停很久，也没有说这是最后一次。至今我仍不知道那把刀有没有被带进新厨房；我能确定的，只是当时把它放进了箱子。

prompt: Edit this personal essay for flow. You may reorder paragraphs, but keep the quiet first-person voice and the limits of memory. Do not add dialogue, motives, or a resolved ending. Return the essay only.
source_text:
The first time I returned to the swimming pool after leaving school, I went in the afternoon because the timetable listed a public session then. I was thirty-four. I did not go as part of a plan to transform my health, although I had been thinking about swimming for several months. I took an old towel and bought a new pair of goggles at the desk. I cannot remember their colour now.
The changing-room benches seemed lower than I remembered. I do not know whether they had been replaced or whether that was simply how they looked to me. A child was trying to pull a sleeve through a wet coat while an adult held the coat open. I did not hear what they said. In my school years I often lost track of my locker key, but on this visit I kept checking the small plastic band around my wrist.
I swam four lengths, rested at the shallow end, and then swam two more. The pool was twenty-five metres long. I had no watch and did not record how long any of that took. The person in the next lane passed me several times. I could see the steady movement of their feet, but I knew nothing about their training or why they were there. When I left the water, I felt tired and hungry. I did not feel that I had become my younger self again.
At the cafe I bought tea but no cake, because the last slice on the counter had already been reserved. This detail has stayed with me more clearly than the swim itself. I took the tea outside and waited for my bus, holding the paper cup with both hands. It was a dry afternoon; I do not remember whether it was warm.
I went once more the following week. After that, my work schedule changed and I did not return that month. I have sometimes been tempted to make the first visit the beginning of a regular habit, but that is not what happened. The towel stayed on the back of a chair for a while. I do not know exactly how many days.

我大学毕业后第一次回县城，是十月。
那家照相馆早就关了。至少我那次经过时，卷帘门上已经贴着招租纸；它究竟哪天停业，我不知道。
我把带回来的相册又放进了包里。

prompt: 根据真实经历要点写一小段第一人称文字；没有的细节不能补，不必写完整故事。
source_text: 我第一次独自坐夜班火车，17岁，目的地是舅舅家所在的城市。只记得车厢灯整夜亮着，以及鞋放在床下。具体城市、季节、同行乘客和当时心情都记不清。

prompt: 润色这一段，日记的直接引文及档案链接逐字不动，不扩写人物心理。
source_text: 我翻到日记的一页，写着“今天没有等到船”。旁边没有原因，也没写我等了多久。扫描在 https://archive.example.org/diary/p18#scan 。现在我甚至不能确定那天是否下雨。

source_text: My brother and I carried the table downstairs. We had not spoken for months before that morning. Moving the table did not settle the argument; we discussed only which end would fit through the door.

source_text: 去年秋天去看以前住的巷子；入口围挡；从外面看不到老屋；碰到卖水果的人，但没问他巷子情况；不知道老屋还在不在；带去的旧钥匙没有试。
